title: Drone strikes warehouse in southern Russia, online retailer Ozon claims
summary: A drone struck a logistics center belonging to Russian online retail giant Ozon in southern Russia's Adygea Republic overnight on Nov. 4, the company claimed in a press release.

title: New Jersey governor warns importing Russian diesel 'will be met with harsh penalties' amid Trump deal
summary: "Any effort to profit from the illegal trade in Russian fuel will be met with harsh penalties. I urge you to turn away any tanker that seeks to use your facilities in furtherance of such unlawful activity," New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill wrote to ports in the state.
